# Drata

> Primary category: [enterprise-grc](../categories/enterprise-grc.md).

**One-liner** — Compliance automation: continuous control monitoring and automated evidence collection for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR and 14+ other frameworks — [vanta](vanta.md)'s closest competitor.

**What it does** — Connects to your cloud, identity, HR, and dev stack; continuously monitors controls against compliance frameworks; auto-collects audit evidence; runs the audit workflow. Expanded via tuck-ins: SafeBase (trust centers, announced 2025-01), oak9 (code-level CI/CD controls) and Harmonize (2024). Sacra estimates 8,000+ customers and $100M+ ARR by 2025.

**Naming / provenance** — Single brand since founding; no renames found.

**Ownership & viability** — `independent`, VC-backed. $200M Series C announced 2022-12-07 at a **$2B valuation**, co-led by ICONIQ Growth and GGV Capital (Alkeon, Salesforce Ventures, S Ventures also in). No acquisition found as of 2026-07-27; at this valuation it is an IPO-or-large-acquisition candidate rather than a tuck-in target.

**Positioning & differentiators** — The head-to-head rival to [vanta](vanta.md) in compliance automation; both function as lightweight GRC for firms that don't want [servicenow](servicenow.md)/[archer](archer.md) weight. Framework breadth (14+) and continuous monitoring are the pitch; SafeBase adds a customer-facing trust-center/security-questionnaire angle that overlaps [vendor-risk](../categories/vendor-risk.md) from the vendor side.

**Who should choose them / anti-fit** — Fits a mid-size firm chasing SOC 2/ISO certification with a small security team. Anti-fit: a large regulated fund that already runs a heavyweight GRC system of record — Drata complements rather than replaces it.

**Known weaknesses / gotchas** — Like Vanta, audit/cert-flavored rather than a full risk register; AI-governance coverage thinner than the dedicated platforms.

**Deployment & data handling** — SaaS. Data handling specifics unverified.

**Integrations & partnerships** — Broad connector library (cloud, IdP, MDM, ticketing) per vendor docs; unverified in detail.

**Compliance & FS traction** — Unverified; customer base skews tech/mid-market.

**Commercial** — Pricing not public; tiered SaaS subscription.
